name: Nachon
overview: The location known as Nachon, also called Chidon, is significant as the place where Uzzah was struck down by God for his irreverent act of touching the ark of God to steady it when the oxen stumbled. This event, recorded in 2 Samuel 6:6-7 and 1 Chronicles 13:9, highlights God's holiness and the seriousness of approaching Him with proper reverence. Uzzah's death at Nachon's threshing floor serves as a solemn reminder of the consequences of rashness before the Lord, emphasizing the need for obedience and respect in worship.
